instruction: Lay the shirt flat in the outline, face up, collar on the left.

text: [app] Step 1/5: "Lay the shirt flat in the outline, face up, collar on the left." Notes: Ask them to say ready when it is flat. You may also see it in the camera frames. This step needs your judgment: call advance_step with the reason when you see it done. Tell them what to do in under 15 words.
Lay the shirt flat in the outline, face up, collar on the left.

instruction: With your left hand, pinch the shirt at the shoulder dot.

text: [app] Step 1 done (user confirmed). Step 2/5: "With your left hand, pinch the shirt at the shoulder dot." Targets: shoulder dot. Tell them what to do in under 15 words.
With your left hand, pinch the shirt at the shoulder dot.
[app] left hand pinched near shoulder dot (2 cm).

instruction: Keep holding. With your right hand, pinch the middle dot.

text: [app] Step 2 done (detected). Step 3/5: "Keep holding. With your right hand, pinch the middle dot." Targets: middle dot. Notes: This is where the planted demo mistake happens: pinching too close to the near edge. Tell them what to do in under 15 words.
Keep holding. With your right hand, pinch the middle dot.

message: Slide your right hand up to the dot.

text: [app] Mistake "pinch_too_low": Slide your right hand up to the dot. Correct them now in a few words.
Slide your right hand up to the dot.
[app] right hand pinched near middle dot (2 cm).

instruction: Cross your left hand over your right and pinch the hem dot.

text: [app] Step 3 done (detected). Step 4/5: "Cross your left hand over your right and pinch the hem dot." Targets: hem dot. Notes: Hardest step. Tracking can flicker while the hands cross, so the radii are loose on purpose. Offer show_demo early. Tell them what to do in under 15 words.
Cross your left hand over your right and pinch the hem dot.

instruction: Lift both hands, uncross them, and lay the shirt down folded.

text: [app] Step 4 done (detected). Step 5/5: "Lift both hands, uncross them, and lay the shirt down folded." Notes: Celebrate when it is done. If the fold is messy, offer to go again. This step needs your judgment: call advance_step with the reason when you see it done. Tell them what to do in under 15 words.
Lift both hands, uncross them, and lay the shirt down folded.
